contexts.text: A dove = the truths and goods of faith with one who is to be regenerated. Illustrated.

The dove which came upon Jesus when He was baptized = the Holy of faith; and the baptism itself, regeneration; hence with the new Church which was rising up, the truth and good of faith, which they receive by regeneration from the Lord.
The like was represented by the young pigeons or turtle-doves which they offered in sacrifice. Illustrated.
That a dove, in general, = the intellectual things of faith. Illustrated.
He sent forth a dove from himself to see () = a state of receiving the truths and goods of faith. AC 890.
The dove found no rest for the sole of her foot () = that nothing of the good and truth of faith could as yet take root. A dove = the truth of faith.
She returned to him to the ark = that the good and truth meant by the dove returned to him again. Whatever good a man supposes he does of himself, returns to him...
To put forth his hand, take the dove, and pull her in to himself = to apply and attribute to himself the truth which is meant by the dove.
The dove did not return to him anymore = a free state; (for) the dove, or the truth of faith... was no longer kept in the ark on account of the waters of the Flood.
As a dove out of the land of Asshur ()... A dove = rational good. AE 601:7.
Doves and turtle-doves (in the sacrifices) represented spiritual things.

A turtle-dove and a young pigeon () = the things which are representative of the spiritual things of the Church; a turtle-dove, those which are exterior; and a young pigeon, those which are interior. Compare AC 1823. AC 1826. AC 1827.
The wings of a dove covered with silver (). The wings of a dove = the truth of faith. That a dove = faith, see AC 870.
The son of a dove, and a turtle-dove () = innocence. AE 314:end. ( = the good of innocence. AC 10210:end.)
He saw the Holy Spirit descending like a dove; a dove is the representative of purification and regeneration through Divine truth.
A reformed man may be compared to a dove as to the understanding, and to a sheep as to the will.

They looked to the window in the southern quarter, and lo, there appeared a bright white dove with wings glistening like silver, and its head made conspicuous by a crown as of gold; it was standing on a branch out of which came forth an olive; and when it was in the effort to expand its wings, the wives said, We will open something. While that dove appears it is a sign to us that it is allowable. CL 208. CL 208:4.
We do not want to say more, and therefore we cannot, because the dove of our window... has flown away. I waited its return, but in vain.
There was a sound as of the dove moaning; and then the wives said, This is a sign to us that we earnestly desire to divulge still more secret things, but that it is not allowable.
There appeared afar as it were a flying dove with the leaf of a tree in its mouth; but as it approached, in place of the dove there appeared a little boy with a paper in his hand.
He was again seen afar as a dove flying, but with a coronet on its head.

He saw at his right hand... a flying dove, and at his left... a vulture; and he said... Your faith has seduced you. Is it not in your hands as a snare for catching doves? Hearing this, a certain magician formed as it were a snare from that faith, and hung it on a tree, saying, You will see that I shall catch that dove. Just then a hawk flew up... and was caught; and the dove, seeing the hawk, flew by.

John saw the Holy Spirit descending like a dove. This took place because baptism = regeneration and purification; in like manner a dove. Who cannot perceive that the dove was not the Holy Spirit, and that the Holy Spirit was not in the dove? Doves often appear in Heaven; and whenever they appear, the Angels know that they are correspondences of the affections and thence the thoughts in relation to regeneration and purification, with those who are standing by...
Saying at heart, that theological matters are specious snares for catching doves.
The things I ate... as pigeons...
I have sometimes observed in sleep that in my garden at Stockholm there were various abodes of doves...
A dove out of the land of Assyria = the Rational. AE 1100:20.
As doves to the windows ()... Doves = the spiritual affection of truth.
Who will give me the wing as of a dove? I will fly away to where I dwell ()... The wing of a dove = the spiritual affection of truth.
The wings of a dove covered with silver = spiritual truths... (for) a wing = what is spiritual; a dove, truth from good; and silver, truth itself.
As doves to their windows... Doves = the goods in the sense of the letter of the Word.
A dove, which is meant by Jona = spiritual good. References.
Be ye like the dove that maketh her nest in the sides of the pit's mouth ()... = a view of truth from without and not from within...
The dove which Noah sent forth = the good of charity, which was the essential of that Church.
The dove sent forth anew = the second successive state, which exists when spiritual good begins to come forth through truths, after falsities have been removed.
It is said as a dove out of the land of Assyria, because a dove = rational good from what is spiritual.
Ephraim is like a silly dove, without heart () = that now there is no Intellectual, because no truth, nor affection of truth and good.
Under Bear, see this reference.
The seats of those that sold doves () = (those who make gain) from holy goods.
In the Heavens there are turtle-doves, doves. etc.
The natural man separated from the spiritual is like a hawk pursuing a dove.
